green label with white text and black bean image
text 'Clande Tkin 8Pney' on the label
text 'BESTERBENC' below the main text
text 'on Revk tllc' below 'BESTERBENC'
yellow band with black beans at the bottom of the label

detail.issues: Model A has incorrect text ('BESTERLENG' instead of 'BESTERBENC'), missing the top rope detail, and altered bean image. Model B has significant text errors ('Cian' instead of 'Clande', 'BESTER' instead of 'BESTERBENC'), missing the top rope, and incorrect bean placement.
Model A has incorrect panel shapes and stitching details, while Model B has smoother panels and less accurate stitching compared to the reference.
Model A has slightly off clock hands and minor texturing differences; Model B has more accurate clock hands but exhibits surface distortion and inconsistent lighting compared to the reference.
Model A has incorrect proportions and details in the gondola and lower structure, while Model B has a significantly distorted and simplified gondola shape with missing structural elements.
Model A has incorrect number labels (e.g., '8', '18' instead of '0', '1') and misaligned segments. Model B has color inaccuracies (e.g., red ring color, segment colors) and misaligned numbers.

features.feature: long, slender wooden pen shaft
metallic nib with a pointed tip
feather attached to the pen shaft
white band connecting the feather to the shaft
metallic ring near the nib
light brown wooden pen shaft

detail.issues: Model A has incorrect feather color and shape, missing the white band on the feather, and a simplified nib. Model B has incorrect feather color and shape, missing the white band, and a simplified nib with wrong details.
Model A has incorrect bead arrangement and missing beads on the curved surface; Model B has incorrect bead colors and arrangement, and the stand's wood texture is less detailed.
